target_customer: Small local businesses and merchants associations, reached through newspapers and associations acting as resellers
problem: Small businesses wanted websites, member directories and social posting but were pitched by many startups; newspapers and merchants associations wanted new revenue from selling them tools.
business_model: Reseller channel with revenue share, plus tools sold to newspapers and associations (hosting, member directory, member billing)
product_category: Small business web marketing and CRM

founders.name: David Currant (Tolioupov)
founders.background_notes: YC profile says he later founded Mustard and co-founded GoSkip (acquired by Standard AI) and Zensoft.io, and is building MXPilot. The order versus LocalOn is not stated.

founders.name: Shahbano Imran
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page as founder and named by TechCrunch in 2013. YC page says she is now a fractional product lead.

exit.reason: Not public. YC lists the company as inactive; no shutdown or acquisition news found.

competitors.name: Barley
competitors.what: Website builder for small businesses, named as one of a wave of similar services

technical_complexity.rationale: A website builder with ecommerce support and automatic posting to social networks and listings used standard web components and integrations.

defensibility.rationale: The reseller relationships with newspapers and merchants associations gave some distribution lock in, but the product category was crowded and the tools were copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying LocalOn. ReachLocal and Yodle are plausible rivals but no 2013 source ties them to LocalOn.

market_need_then: TechCrunch in August 2013 said small businesses were pitched by 20 startups a day. Reported results were 50,000 dollars of new business in six months through the East Bay Express and a 20 percent rise in annual membership revenue at OaklandGrown.

branding.domain_note: localon.com; the site fetch was blocked by a rate limited safety check so domain history is unknown.

brand_strength.rationale: Only the launch article and directory listings exist. Several similarly named local marketing companies appear in search, which makes the name easy to confuse.

outcome_analysis: LocalOn sold small business marketing tools mainly through newspapers and merchants associations, with 40 associations and two Bay Area newspapers as partners at launch in August 2013. The directory lists it as inactive but no source explains why, and no funding was found, so the cause of the stall is not public and failure factors are left empty.
notes: No funding information found in two searches; VCBacked and Crunchbase pages showed no amounts. Competitor list contains one dated source; modern aggregator pages for Yodle, ReachLocal and OwnLocal were excluded as undated for 2013. localon.com could not be fetched (safety check rate limited), so the site status is unknown.
